parameters.pressure: 0.05 MPa (Ar backfill after vacuum to 5 Pa)
parameters.cooling_method: poured into high purity graphite crucible

other.raw_material_purity: Al, Co, Ni 99.9 wt%; Cr, Fe 99.5-99.6 wt%

evidence.quote: After the vacuum reached 5 Pa, the raw materials were melted under a vacuum of 0.05 MPa by backfilling pure argon (Ar). The liquid metal was held at 1500 °C for 15 min and then poured into a high purity graphite crucible.

attributes.phase_fraction: 69.19 vol% (combined FCC and B2 ratio counted)

evidence.quote: The ratio of the two-phase in as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.2 was counted with Image-Pro Plus software and the volume fraction of the FCC and B2 phases were about 69.19% and 30.81%, respectively.

attributes.phase_fraction: 30.81 vol% (combined FCC and B2 ratio counted)

evidence.quote: the volume fraction of the FCC and B2 phases were about 69.19% and 30.81%, respectively

attributes.morphology: lamellar mixture of CoCrFeNi-rich FCC and NiAl-rich B2

evidence.quote: the primary phase was the CoCrFeNi-rich FCC solid solution and the lamellar eutectic structure was a mixture of CoCrFeNi-rich FCC and NiAl-rich B2 solid solution phases

attributes.composition: Al-rich B2 precipitates (Al content doubled relative to matrix)

evidence.quote: A lot of precipitated phases clearly appeared in the primary phase.

attributes.composition: Al-rich, Al 15.7 at%, Co 16.3 at%, Cr 14.9 at%, Fe 16.7 at%, Ni 36.3 at%

evidence.quote: the FCC primary phases transformed to the rich-Al B2 precipitates and poor-Al matrix phases. The atomic ratio of Al in the precipitates doubled to that of the matrix of primary phases.
with the increase in the homogenizing temperature, the size of the precipitates increased significantly
with the increase in the homogenizing temperature, the size of the precipitates increased significantly

attributes.morphology: ductile dimples in primary FCC phases

evidence.quote: The primary FCC phases showed a ductile fracture with dimples characteristic (marked as elliptic region).

attributes.morphology: equiaxed dimples; increased proportion of small dimples

evidence.quote: After homogenized, the proportion of small dimples increased significantly, while only a small part of them existed in as-cast Ni2.2 alloy.

conditions.test_method: micro-Vickers hardness, 1000 g load, average of five measurements

evidence.quote: The average hardness of the as-cast Ni2.2 alloy was HV296.
After homogenized at 900 °C, 1000 °C, and 1100 °C, the hardness decreased and was around HV250.

evidence.quote: The tensile fracture strength of the as-cast alloy reached 900 MPa, while the elongation was 18%.
